title: RDDMPI: Residual Denoising Diffusion Model for Probabilistic Multivariate Time Series Imputation
abstract: arXiv:2609.11648v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multivariate time series imputation (MTSI) aims to recover missing values in temporal data composed of multiple interdependent variables. This problem is central to real-world applications such as healthcare monitoring, traffic networks, and energy systems. Recent diffusion-based approaches have shown strong potential for probabilistic imputation by learning to generate missing values through iterative denoising. However, most existing approaches perform diffusion directly in the original data space, requiring the denoising network to simultaneously capture global structure, temporal dynamics, and stochastic variability. This makes the generative task unnecessarily complex, especially when modern deterministic imputers can already provide accurate initial reconstructions. translated_title: RDDMPI：用于概率多元时间序列插补的残差去噪扩散模型
translated_abstract: 多元时间序列插补（MTSI）旨在恢复由多个相互依赖变量组成的时间数据中的缺失值。这一问题对于医疗监测、交通网络和能源系统等现实应用至关重要。近年来基于扩散的方法通过学习迭代去噪来生成缺失值，在概率插补方面展现出强大潜力。然而，大多数现有方法直接在原始数据空间中执行扩散，要求去噪网络同时捕捉全局结构、时间动态和随机变异性。这使得生成任务变得不必要的复杂，尤其是在现代确定性插补器已经能够提供准确初始重建的情况下。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了RDDMPI，一种直接在残差空间中运行的条件残差扩散框架。该方法不再建模完整的缺失数据本身，而是（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了RDDMPI框架，通过在残差空间而非原始数据空间执行条件扩散，利用确定性插补器的初始重建结果简化生成任务，实现更高效的多元时间序列概率插补。
en_tdlr: RDDMPI, a conditional residual diffusion framework operating in residual space instead of the original data space, simplifies the generative task for probabilistic multivariate time series imputation by leveraging accurate initial reconstructions from deterministic imputers.
